title: Brake feel, noise, and regenerative braking
summary: Feedback on braking centers on strong stopping performance and regenerative braking appreciation, alongside complaints about squeaking, brake dust, abrupt braking feel, and many fragments that lack enough context to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise strong braking performance and useful regenerative braking range recovery.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on brake squeaking or squealing, brake dust buildup, and other braking concerns with limited detail in some examples.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews mention brake noise or dust but the examples are too limited to clearly capture the offsetting positive element.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention brakes, pedal feel, calipers, or regenerative braking behavior without enough context to assign a clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined or very short, which limits confidence in identifying specific sentiment themes.
Several assigned sentiments do not match the fragment wording alone, so the surrounding review context is missing.
The topic includes related but distinct subtopics such as brake noise, brake dust, pedal feel, and regenerative braking, which reduces thematic coherence in the sample.
